chunks: Ali, from Muhammad ibn Isa, from Yunus, from a man, from Zurara, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) who said:
The ones with distorted hearts have never been more numerous than they are today.

key_terms.الْمُؤَلَّفَةُ قُلُوبُهُمْ: Those whose hearts are reconciled; a specific group mentioned in the Quran, often interpreted in Shia tradition as those with distorted or reconciled hearts in a specific context.
key_terms.الْيَوْمَ: Today; referring to the contemporary era of the narrator or the general present time relative to the Imam.

ai.seo_question: Who are the Mu'allafatu Qulubuhum and why are they more numerous today?
ai.summary: Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) observes that the category of 'Al-Mu'allafatu Qulubuhum'—traditionally those reconciled to Islam through gifts or influence—is currently more numerous than at any other time, suggesting a proliferation of superficial or strategic adherence. This statement, recorded in al-Kafi, reflects the Shia scholarly view that this group has expanded significantly, often comprising those who outwardly conform for worldly gain rather than genuine faith. The emphasis on their current numerical superiority serves as a diagnostic indicator of the spiritual and social climate during the Imam's era.
